summary: Barings Private Credit Corp filed an 8-K reporting routine items: an unregistered sale of ~1.68M shares at a per-share price determined under the Investment Company Act (approx. $19.91, no explicit premium), noting the continuous private offering remains open; a regular monthly distribution declaration of $0.167 per share; and updated NAV ($19.92) and NII ($0.57) as of June 30, 2026. These are normal operational and compliance updates for a BDC, not a special situation.
